messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [SEV2] Automated alert: elevated tail latency and streaming truncation affecting long-context generation (>70k tokens) in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Symptoms: partial/truncated streamed responses and spikes in p95/p99 token latency. Impact: ~4% of hosted text-generation streams. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/shard-rebalancer

emily_oncall: Oncall here — I'm triaging. Initial signal shows kernel OOMs and KV cache thrash on a subset of model-shard rebalancer instances after the 23:04 deploy. Triage channel: #eng-runtime. Escalating to SRE and model routing owners. Paging kai_sre and jamal_eng.

kai_sre: Confirmed. New rebalancer heuristic aggressively moved shards during cold-starts — caused hot loops and memory pressure. Immediate mitigations in progress: 1) pin shard placements for active customers, 2) reduce rebalancer concurrency to 0.3, 3) set autoscaler cooldown to 5m. Applying pins now.

jamal_eng: Patch ready to add backpressure and jitter on rebalancer. Merged to canary (deploy 2057001280). Patch: PR#4123. Fallback plan: revert rebalancer commit from 23:04 if canary shows no improvement.

sara_ops: Customer comms: preparing status page update. Draft status: "We are experiencing partial stream truncations for a small subset of customers in US/EU while we mitigate a routing bug. No data loss; requests may need retry." ETA to publish: ~8m. Will notify Account teams for impacted customers.

maria_cs: Notifying top 5 affected customers via DM with the temporary workaround: retry stream with the same request_id to resume. Sharing the status link once live.

dinesh_ops: After pinning placements p99 dropped from 2.6s to 1.1s for affected shard group. Continuing to monitor metrics and OOM counts. Holding post-mitigate observation window 30m.

emily_oncall: Current status: mitigation applied (shard pins + reduced concurrency). Partial impact persists but trending down. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2057001234. Runbook + deploy links: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/shard-rebalancer and https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2057001280. Next: monitor 30m, if stable schedule rollback of aggressive heuristic and follow up with postmortem. :white_check_mark:

kai_sre: Action items assigned: jamal_eng (deploy fix), dinesh_ops (monitoring), sara_ops (customer updates), emily_oncall (postmortem owner).
